## Download

Download the archive for your system, unpack it and run `symphony` (`symphony.exe` on Windows): the office opens in your browser at <http://127.0.0.1:7788/>. Install the mod in Claude Code with `claude plugin install symphony-bridge --marketplace feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony`. The [README](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony#readme) has the details.

| System | x86-64 | ARM64 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux | [`symphony_linux_amd64.tar.gz`](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony/releases/download/{tag}/symphony_linux_amd64.tar.gz) | [`symphony_linux_arm64.tar.gz`](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony/releases/download/{tag}/symphony_linux_arm64.tar.gz) |
| macOS | [`symphony_darwin_amd64.tar.gz`](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony/releases/download/{tag}/symphony_darwin_amd64.tar.gz) (Intel) | [`symphony_darwin_arm64.tar.gz`](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony/releases/download/{tag}/symphony_darwin_arm64.tar.gz) (Apple silicon) |
| Windows | [`symphony_windows_amd64.zip`](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony/releases/download/{tag}/symphony_windows_amd64.zip) | [`symphony_windows_arm64.zip`](https://github.com/feynmanzcys-bytes/symphony/releases/download/{tag}/symphony_windows_arm64.zip) |

`checksums.txt` holds the SHA-256 of every archive; the README's install steps check it. The programs aren't signed, so macOS and Windows may stop the first run; the README says how to let it through.
